note: Expectations derived by hand by stepping gup.c/memory.c at 6b25e21 and the 19be0eaffa3a diff on paper, before running the explorer. 'written' is the page the GUP caller writes in a sequential run with an optional single zap after A's step k (0-based).

sequential.why: none -> cow fault C(r,dirty) -> follow NULL -> wp reuse, VM_FAULT_WRITE clears FOLL_WRITE -> follow returns C
step 3 is the reuse fault; after the zap FOLL_WRITE is gone, so the read fault maps P and follow returns it
zap after the first cow fault: FOLL_WRITE still set, so the next fault is another cow fault
FOLL_COW set but FOLL_WRITE kept; the next fault is a cow fault; can_follow_write_pte accepts the dirty C

explore.why: faultin_page only drops FOLL_WRITE when !(vm_flags & VM_WRITE)
